caption: The chain is identical for both link types; only the final block changes, reporting BER for a digital link and CNR for an analog one.

spec.title: The five blocks of a point-to-point link
spec.aria: Block diagram running top to bottom through source and driver, fiber and splices, photodiode, preamplifier and filter, decision circuit, ending in a measurement block that reports bit error rate or carrier-to-noise ratio.
